mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role memberships JOIN sys_role roles ON roles.role_id = memberships.role_id AND roles.tenant_id = memberships.tenant_id JOIN sys_role_menu role_grants ON role_grants.role_id = roles.role_id AND role_grants.tenant_id = roles.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu menus ON menus.menu_id = role_grants.menu_id WHERE memberships.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND memberships.user_id = users.user_id AND roles.status = '0' AND roles.deleted = 0 AND menus.status = '0' AND menus.perms = 'workflow:task:complete')
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(nick_name, ''), user_name) AS name FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = '0' AND deleted = 0

SELECT users.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(users.nick_name, ''), users.user_name) AS name FROM crm_customer customers JOIN sys_user users ON users.user_id = customers.owner_id AND users.tenant_id = customers.tenant_id WHERE customers.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customers.customer_id = #{customerId} AND customers.deleted = 0 AND users.status = '0' AND users.deleted = 0 AND

SELECT DISTINCT users.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(users.nick_name, ''), users.user_name) AS name FROM sys_user users JOIN sys_user_role memberships ON memberships.user_id = users.user_id AND memberships.tenant_id = users.tenant_id JOIN sys_role roles ON roles.role_id = memberships.role_id AND roles.tenant_id = memberships.tenant_id WHERE users.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND users.status = '0' AND users.deleted = 0 AND roles.role_key = 'finance' AND roles.status = '0' AND roles.deleted = 0 AND users.user_id != #{applicantId} AND users.user_id != #{ownerId} AND ORDER BY users.user_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user users WHERE users.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND users.user_id = #{userId} AND users.status = '0' AND users.deleted = 0 AND )

SELECT definition_id, process_key, version, model_json FROM wf_process_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_key = 'crm_refund_review' AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(is_archived, 0) = 0 ORDER BY version DESC, definition_id LIMIT 1
SELECT definition_id, process_key, version, model_json FROM wf_process_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND definition_id = #{definitionId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT instance_id, definition_id, process_def_key, business_key, start_user_id, status, variables FROM wf_process_instance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT task_id, node_key, operator_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, action, task_type, create_time FROM wf_task_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND action IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE', 'REJECT', 'COUNTERSIGN_REJECT') ORDER BY create_time, history_id
